name: Hau nuong pho mai
summary: Hàu nướng phô mai is oysters grilled with cheese on Đầm Lập An. The rock oyster, firm and strongly fragrant, is the one favored this way.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024, and VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016.
texture: The rock oyster is firm and strongly fragrant, and it is the oyster favored for the cheese.
seoTitle: Hau nuong pho mai in Lang Co — oysters and cheese
seoDescription: Hàu nướng phô mai is oysters grilled with cheese on Đầm Lập An. The rock oyster is firm and strongly fragrant.
